text:
devon: heads-up - deploying runtime v5.0 to canary revealed a subtle function-call payload truncation when clients use the new sdk-client 4.x function-calling helpers. putting a scoped pin while we investigate.

deploy-bot: created pin 'pin-330505' (scope=runtime:v5.0, route:functions, region:global-canary). Reason: function-call payload truncation with sdk-client 4.x. owners=[devon,mei].

mei: can you paste a minimal failing exchange? was it correlated with any kernel warnings?

devon: short trace from canary: `FunctionPayloadTruncated: expected_len=2048 actual_len=1760 at func/call_serializer.cpp:87`

build-bot: repro job queued (matrix: runtime=5.0/4.9, sdk=3.9/4.0) on canary-nodes. Will post results.

ops-lead: suggestion: route function-call traffic in canary to runtime v4.9 for sessions using sdk>=4.0 while we triage. That avoids cutting user-visible payloads. deploy-bot can do route-level pins by header match.

deploy-bot: suggested command: `/deploy route-update --route canary-functions --match "header:X-SDK-Version>=4.0" --fallback runtime:v4.9` (dry-run available).

mei: I suspect serializer header framing changed in sdk-client 4.x; might be a compatibility shim there. I'll diff the serializer between 3.9 and 4.0 and try a local shim.

devon: owners: devon+mei. Do not release pin until repro fixed and 4h stable in canary. Also add rollback automation: if function errors >0.2% for 10m, revert routing.

build-bot: repro results: truncation reproduces only when sdk-client adds `func_meta_v2` header and runtime v5.0 serializer expects v1 framing. 4.9 is compatible.

mei: opening PR `sdk-client#623` to add a compatibility shim that emits legacy `func_meta_v1` when on canary header; includes unit test for the failing trace.

devon: approve scoped routing dry-run while shim lands. deploy-bot, please run dry-run and estimate impact.

deploy-bot: dry-run at 3305055400: estimated impact <1.2% traffic shift. No other routes affected. Awaiting explicit approval to promote.

ops-lead: +1 for routing fallback to v4.9 in canary. Approve promote if dry-run is clean. Add console banner: "Scoped compatibility routing active for function-calls in canary for SDK>=4.0" so dedicated customers see it.

devon: promote routing. Keep pin active until shim validated and canary run is stable.

deploy-bot: routing promoted at 3305055450. Pin 'pin-330505' remains active and requires manual release.

mei: shim PR opened and CI green: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-client/pull/623. Deploying shim to canary nodes now (canary-func-01).

build-bot: canary run with shim: function-call payloads pass serialization checks; no truncation observed for test vectors. Starting 4h soak.

ops-lead: monitoring set: alert if function-call truncations >0.05% or p95 latency increases >25% for 10m. Auto-rollback route if triggered.

devon: unhold criteria proposal: 1) unit repro fixed + CI coverage, 2) 4h canary soak with no alerts, 3) 12h stable metrics for function routes, 4) release-note entry and console banner updated.

mei: after 4h soak passes, I'll request manual pin release.

deploy-bot: pin-check reminder scheduled at 3305059050 (+1h, +4h, +12h notifications). Pin will not auto-expire. Manual release: `/deploy pin release pin-330505 --by <owner>`

devon: thanks team. If anyone thinks we should instead rollback runtime v5.0 entirely, post rationale here and we'll escalate. For now routing+shim is lowest-risk. :thumbsup:
